items.title: Quick Start
items.blurb: Install cq and run your first auto-scaling queue, including named and priority queues.

items.title: Common Recipes
items.blurb: Practical, copy-paste patterns: reliable API calls, retry-safe chains, idempotent work, and scheduling.

items.title: Queue Submissions
items.blurb: Submission acceptance and JobHandle behavior — waiting, results, cancellation, and routed/delayed/priority handles.

items.title: Job Wrappers
items.blurb: The full wrapper reference: retries, timeouts, outcomes, tracing, rate limiting, circuit breakers, and workflow composition.

items.title: Queue Routing
items.blurb: Register named queues and route jobs explicitly with QueueManager and isolated worker pools.

items.title: Priority Queue
items.blurb: Weighted fair queuing with priority levels, named priority routing, and graceful drain on shutdown.

items.title: Scheduler
items.blurb: Recurring and one-time job scheduling — intervals, absolute times, and cron-like behavior via external parsers.

items.title: Custom Locker
items.blurb: Distributed lock implementations for WithUnique and WithoutOverlap, including a Redis example.

items.title: Custom Concurrency Limiter
items.blurb: Distributed limits for WithConcurrencyByKey with a SQLite implementation example.

items.title: Custom Checkpoint Store
items.blurb: Distributed checkpoint implementations for WithCheckpoint with Redis and SQLite examples.

items.title: Queue Options
items.blurb: Queue construction and runtime options: worker idle cleanup, cancellation strategy, panic handling, and custom IDs.

items.title: Observability Contract
items.blurb: Lifecycle and telemetry guarantees for hooks and stats — ordering rules, JobEvent semantics, and counter caveats.
